components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.78rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--bg-elev); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: var(--blue-mid); color: var(--blue-deep); }

components.name: START Button
components.description: The entry control. Entry Water, wide tracking, a soft pulse.
components.css: .ds-btn-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 180px; padding: 0.95rem 1.8rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #1f6f9c; color: #fff; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.18em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(31, 111, 156, 0.28); animation: ds-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-btn-start:hover, .ds-btn-start:focus-visible { background: #15577d; outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-5px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-start { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The Sky Briefing is a pale page that reads as a sheet of findings. A faint sky grid sits behind the type. Fraunces carries the name and the section titles. Plus Jakarta Sans carries the evidence. Decoration stays small: the grid, a hairline, and the clouds at the door.

The page is calm, airy, and precise. Soft sky first, then the facts. Lake Ink does the reading. Daylight Blue marks the few things that should be touched: the second half of the name, a link, a project number, an icon. The START screen is weather you pass through. Behind it, the page is a document.

Depth is a cool lift, not a gray drop. The shared shadow is a wide, faint lake-blue cast. It sits under the mobile menu, and the same cast may sit under cards. Panels stay white and hairlined so the sheet stays easy to read.
keyCharacteristics: Pale sky ground, lake-ink text, one daylight accent
Serif for the name and titles, sans for the evidence
A document first: label column, prose, hairline panels
Pills only on actions and skill tags
Cool blue lift, and never a dark dashboard

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: Daylight Blue marks a meaning: the emphasized name, a link, a project number, an icon. The paler sky colors are atmosphere. They do not fill a briefing-page button at rest.

rules.name: The No Dashboard Rule
rules.body: The system stays on Paper Sky. No black canvas, no neon chart colors, no dense instrument panels.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fraunces speaks the name and the section titles. Plus Jakarta Sans speaks the evidence. Body copy does not go in the serif, and the hero name does not go in the sans.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Content sits in a 1120px column. A 180px label column introduces each section, widening to 280px for experience. Below 860px the sheet becomes a single column.

rules.name: The Lake Lift Rule
rules.body: When a surface lifts, the shadow is `0 18px 40px rgba(46, 126, 174, 0.1)`. It is wide, faint, and lake blue. It may sit under cards. A gray or black drop shadow is out.

rules.name: The Pill Exception Rule
rules.body: Fully round corners belong to actions and skill tags. Panels, project rows, tabs, and the MN mark keep their softer corners.

dos: Do keep the ground on Paper Sky and the reading text in Lake Ink.
Do use Fraunces for the name and section titles, and Plus Jakarta Sans for the evidence, labels, and buttons.
Do keep the sheet: a 180px label column, 18px panels, and a 1px sky hairline.
Do limit pills to buttons and skill tags.
Do use the lake lift when a surface needs to rise. Cards may take it.
Do keep Daylight Blue for the emphasized name, links, project numbers, and icons.
donts: Don't build a dark analytics dashboard: no black canvas, no neon chart colors, no dense instrument panels.
Don't set the hero name in Plus Jakarta Sans, or the body copy in Fraunces.
Don't fill briefing-page buttons with Daylight Blue at rest. That color is the hover and the accent.
Don't add decoration beyond the sky grid, the hairline, and the clouds on the START screen.
Don't promote the unused `--blue` value (`#89c9e8`) into a new accent. It is declared and paints nothing.
